people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: When the seventh month had come, and the children of Israel were in the cities, the people gathered themselves together as one man to Jerusalem.
translations.bsb: By the seventh month, the Israelites had settled in their towns, and the people assembled as one man in Jerusalem.
translations.kjv: And when the seventh month was come, and the children of Israel were in the cities, the people gathered themselves together as one man to Jerusalem.
